$comment: Demo applications shown on /demos (docs/PLAN-R4.md section 4.6, C8). Add an entry per demo; images live in public/media/demos/<id>/ and are captured by scripts/capture.mjs. `url` is optional (https only); without it the page shows the run-locally steps.

demos.name: PeopleHub HRMS
demos.summary: A human resources application that uses AbsoluteUI for every control: a rearrangeable dashboard, employee directory, onboarding, leave and shifts, payroll, analytics, recruitment, projects, performance reviews, and an organization chart.
demos.stack: Node.js HTTP server, PostgreSQL 17, AbsoluteUI components; no UI or CSS framework

screens.title: Dashboard
screens.caption: A rearrangeable dashboard, saved per user.

screens.title: Organization
screens.caption: The reporting hierarchy as an org chart.

runLocally: Install Node.js 22.13 or later and PostgreSQL 17.
Copy apps/demo-hrms/.env.example to apps/demo-hrms/.env and set the database connection.
Run npm install and npm run build (AbsoluteUI packages).
Run npm run demo:db to create, migrate, and seed the database.
Run npm run demo and open http://127.0.0.1:4350.
